brand.name: West Monroe
brand.intended_use: Canonical reference for humans and LLMs creating West Monroe-branded digital demos and UX/UI assets

rules.corner_radius_exception: Layout surfaces are square by default. Approved buttons and search fields may use the rounded 80px component treatment.
rules.heading_font_source: Load IBM Plex Sans from Google Fonts or an approved self-hosted equivalent.
rules.body_font_fallback: Use Helvetica followed by sans-serif only when Arial is unavailable.

logo.rule: Use the full horizontal logo for all brand placements. Use the compass only as a favicon.

llm_summary: Use IBM Plex Sans for headings, headlines, display type, and eyebrow text.
Use Arial for body copy, navigation, labels, controls, and captions.
Load IBM Plex Sans from the documented Google Fonts URL or an approved self-hosted equivalent.
Use Canvas Gray #F8F8F8 as the default page background.
Use White for content surfaces and Grounded Blue for text, structure, controls, and dark sections.
Use square corners for layout surfaces.
Approved buttons and search fields may use rounded component corners.
Use borders, solid blocks, spacing, and scale for hierarchy.
Use approved logos and assets only.
Follow WCAG 2.0 AA accessible text/background combinations.
